title: Recovery, response and maintenance actions
description: Actions form a tree: atomic actions are leaves with concrete requirements; composite actions combine other actions with all_of, any_of or k_of_n. Actions are parameterised by entities of the setup ontology; arguments and expressions are written as `$name` or `$name.attribute.path` and are resolved against the plan (plus the derived helpers: `copies` of a secret, i.e. its (backup, item) pairs; `seeds` of a device; `wallets` of a seed, passphrase or device; `devices` of a descriptor; `enclosing_bags` of a backup or device, outermost first; `bags`, `devices` and `backups` stored in or at a location (recursively); `items` of a backup; `people`, `locations` and `wallets` of a plan; `is_cloud` and `is_physical` of a location; `all_signers` of a wallet over all policies; `immediate_policy` of a wallet, i.e. the policy without delay; `default_descriptor` of a wallet, truthy for a default definition). Which actions help against which threat is stored here (`responds_to`), not in the threat catalogue.

class.description: Ontology class (including the nested parts Signer, SpendingPolicy, BackupItem), or Number; the loader checks it.

type.description: reach: physical access to a Location, bag, device or backup, including the containers it sits in (decided by Location.access). have: a tool or capability from the vocabulary in `what`. wait: a delay in blocks. intact: the item still exists and is unmodified.

foreach.description: Repeat the step for every element of the collection and bind it to `as`.

when.description: Only if the expression is present or true in the plan.

purpose.description: access: obtain the ability to use funds or information. restore: rebuild a lost element. response: react to an incident. maintenance: recurring upkeep. setup: create something new.

combinator.description: Composite actions only. all_of: every step. any_of: one alternative suffices. k_of_n: at least k steps (usually over a foreach).
